name: Previews
description: Shows PDFs page by page, CSV files and workbooks as tables, and Mermaid diagrams, each format behind its own switch.
author: Seti

pdf.title: PDF
pdf.description: Shows a PDF one page at a time, fitted to the width and zoomable. Off, a PDF offers its download.

sheets.title: Spreadsheets and CSV
sheets.description: Shows CSV and TSV files and Excel and OpenDocument workbooks as tables you can filter and copy from. Off, a CSV opens as text and a workbook offers its download.

mermaid.title: Mermaid
mermaid.description: Draws .mmd and .mermaid files and mermaid fences as diagrams. Off, they show as text and code.
